headline: CONS names dominate moves: TRITN -33.33% and PLE -16.67% on K's books, while PPPM +32.26% on AGRI and B-WORK/NVD print double-digit volume spikes.
market_take: Coverage breadth is wide and skewed negative: 38 unusual-trading alerts, with extreme single-day declines in TRITN and PLE, offset by PPPM's +32.26% surge and stretched REIT/property volume in B-WORK (13.3σ) and NVD (14.8σ). Filings are mostly governance/capital housekeeping, but TL (AGRI, K) and AKS delisting (PROP, T) warrant priority follow-up. PF&REIT price action is firmer than PROP, though M-STOR's 5-day -19.4% keeps the subsector mixed.

PPPM +32.26% with 2.89× volume is the standout; TL's high-significance SET clarification (Q2/2026 financial statements) needs prompt RM review.
Quiet on price action; volume spikes at FM (3.0σ) and ICHI (3.3σ) without catalysts in the filing list. TKN continues share repurchase (medium) and MALEE disposed a subsidiary (high).
